title: Claude Code Can Watch Video Now. It Never Plays a Second
description:
Claude Code can watch video now, but it never plays a second of it. The watch plugin grabs the captions first, then cuts the video into frames at every scene change with a cap of one hundred, and Claude reads each frame as a 512 pixel JPEG at about 197 tokens apiece. On the author's own 49 minute test, 100 frames came to about 19.7k tokens while the transcript alone was 26.6k. The catch is caption-less video: a local file or a TikTok sends Whisper to a Groq or OpenAI key. Name the moment you care about and it only pulls frames for that window. Free, MIT licensed, two commands to install.

Repo: https://github.com/bradautomates/claude-video
